title: Empirically Qualify Off-Center Contact and Player Delivery Covariance
acceptance:
The matched shot study provides geometric and numerically verified conditional predictions, not empirical equipment or player accuracy. Independent contact-law and head-parameter sensitivity cannot replace physical validation.

## Acceptance Criteria

Measure clubhead mass, CG location, full inertia tensor and face geometry for each tested head. Obtain instrumented launch velocity/spin and strike-location data across a preregistered center/heel/toe/high/low grid with repeated trials, measurement uncertainties and held-out validation. Compare contact-law and aerodynamic predictions against preregistered error criteria. Collect repeated player delivery variables with synchronized face/path/speed/shaft/strike measurements before fitting and validating covariance or a human distribution.

## External Resources

Requires physical clubs, calibrated launch and strike measurements, laboratory/field access, and human-trial authorization where applicable. No such dataset is available in this task. Retain open and record the obligation in the deferred-validation catalog; do not claim measured accuracy or close from software tests.
